list_skins: list all available built-in and user-installed CLI skins with descriptions and sources
load_skin: load a skin configuration by name from user YAML files or built-in presets
set_active_skin: switch the active CLI skin and return the new SkinConfig object
get_active_skin: retrieve the currently cached active skin configuration
get_prompt_toolkit_style_overrides: generate prompt_toolkit style overrides derived from the active skin for live TUI theming
